_meta.description: Privacy-protocol contracts on Arbitrum One (Railgun, Aztec, Hinkal, Privacy Pools). Not a risk list: with the flag EXCHEQUER_PRIVACY_CATEGORY on, a trace that passes through one shows a note and walks on; it is never a risk hit and never a stop.
_meta.provenance: Contracts the 11 Nov 2026 mixer hunt (#148) found in each protocol's own deployment list (Railgun-Community/shared-models network-config.ts, Hinkal's Smart Contract Addresses page, Privacy Pools' Deployments page, L2BEAT's discovery for Aztec Connect) or in explorer tags (dawsbot/eth-labels @d9b21ae), each checked on chain for contract code (keyless eth_getCode; TronGrid getcontract on Tron) on 11 Nov and re-checked 14 Nov 2026 with the same result. Filed apart from the threat files because no enforcement action names these protocols a mixer.
_meta.verification_note: Each entry is a contract a privacy protocol's own deployment list or an explorer tag names as its shielded pool or entry point, with code on this chain. It says the funds passed through a privacy protocol, so their visible link ends there; it is NOT an accusation against the protocol, its users or anyone who dealt with them.
_meta.category_note: 'privacy' marks a privacy protocol's contract: a note beside the risk screening, never a risk hit, never a stop.
_meta.regenerate_with: Added by hand from the 11 Nov 2026 mixer hunt (#189); check each address's contract code on chain before adding another.
